items.title: Seth McGowan: Will miss time with hamstring injury
items.text:
Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Not yet shut down for season
items.text:
Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce continues to rehab his left heel injury, and the wideout hasn't been ruled out for a return from injured reserve before the end of the season, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Terrance Ferguson: Needs surgery, won't return from IR
items.text:
Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Avoids major ankle injury in Week 11
items.text:
Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Tuten aggravated a right ankle injury in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants, noting that an examination Monday revealed nothing "too bad," Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Cut loose by Niners
items.text:
The 49ers waived Aiyuk on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
